mapper.select: SELECT task_type, COUNT(1) AS task_total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_total, MAX(COALESCE(finish_time, create_time)) AS last_run_time FROM agent_execution_metric WHERE GROUP BY task_type

SELECT trace_id, task_id, task_type, task_sub_type, total_duration_ms, total_tokens, status, COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) AS last_time FROM agent_execution_metric ORDER BY COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
